relations: Griddle heat renders fat, so small bubbles form and pop on the pork belly surfaces.
High surface temperature produces thin steam wisps drifting continuously above the meat, changing shape and position.
Slow camera drift reveals more of the left kimchi pile and upper grill rim, nudging meat rows right.
With no tools present, the food pieces remain undisturbed, neither flipped nor shifted by hand.
caption: The video showcases a close-up view of food sizzling on a flat, dark, oily griddle. Neat rows of sliced pork belly fill the center and right, their edges browned and their surfaces glistening with rendered fat that catches shifting specular highlights. On the left sits a heap of red chili-coated cabbage, its pale stems and thin white enoki-like strands matted with sauce. Thin wisps of steam drift continuously above the meat, changing shape and position from moment to moment. Small bubbles form and pop in the fat, marking an ongoing sizzle rather than any new action. No tools touch the food, and the pieces are left undisturbed, neither flipped nor shifted by hand. A slow, slight camera drift gradually reveals more of the left kimchi pile and the dark upper rim of the grill, nudging the meat rows toward the right edge. The cooking simply continues, unhurried.
